description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Front Bumper End Cap Attachment Hardware Set.
Attach the Front Bumper / Metal Bar to the Plastic End Caps.
Includes Hardware for Both Front Bumper End Caps
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 6 – Clips, Front Bumper Caps
Qty 2 – Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
